metadata.title: Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing the institutional Secure Endpoint Platform, defining how endpoint devices are trusted as execution environments and how that trust is enforced and consumed across the institution.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Secure Endpoint Platform defines the authoritative trust model for endpoint devices, establishing enrollment, cryptographic identity, posture signaling, runtime protection, and lifecycle governance required for devices to act as acceptable execution environments.

props.name: platform-role
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint is a Tier-1 institutional trust platform upon which identity assurance, network access, and data protection depend.

props.name: implements-pattern
props.remarks: This SSPP is the authoritative implementation and assurance anchor for the Secure Endpoint composite pattern.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint relies on Secure Identity for principal-to-device binding and authentication context.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint relies on Secure Network to enforce access decisions based on endpoint trust and posture.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint requires TPM-backed cryptographic keys managed by the institutional Key Management Platform.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint requires PKI-issued device certificates for cryptographically verifiable endpoint identity.

props.name: endpoint-trust-model
props.remarks: Endpoint trust is explicitly granted, continuously evaluated, and revocable; trust is never implicit.

props.name: cryptographic-requirement
props.remarks: Endpoint identity and cryptographic operations must use TPM-backed keys and FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic modules.

props.name: enforcement-boundary
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint defines trust and emits signals; enforcement occurs in Secure Identity, Secure Network, and Secure Data platforms.

props.name: zero-trust-alignment
props.remarks: Endpoint trust and posture are explicit inputs to Zero Trust Policy Decision Points.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint Platform aligns with foundational endpoint, identity, Zero Trust, and platform integrity guidance.

system-implementation.remarks: The Secure Endpoint Platform composes multiple endpoint trust concerns under a unified institutional governance and signaling framework.

roles.title: Endpoint Architecture Authority
roles.remarks: Defines endpoint trust tiers, requirements, and architectural dependencies.

roles.title: Endpoint Security Operations
roles.remarks: Operates endpoint enrollment, posture signaling, threat protection, and lifecycle workflows.

roles.title: Endpoint Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Defines eligibility requirements and approves trust level transitions and exceptions.

control-implementation.remarks: Endpoint trust controls are implemented through Secure Endpoint patterns and enforced by downstream control planes. This SSPP establishes trust authority, dependencies, and inheritance boundaries only.
